name: Hardcore Femdom
source:
You play as Walker who is a secret agent of the CIA. His goal is to destroy a criminal organization “Hardcore Femdom”
Your mission is to eliminate the Dominatrixes or one Master. The boss of the organization is Goddess Diabolica.
